samples.summary: moveRangeTo no longer overwrites destination cells at spill-ghost offsets, so pre-existing destination data survives inside the "moved" block and now blocks the anchor's re-spill

finding.summary: Cut-paste source clearing still bypasses the `consumeSpillBlocker()` contract the diff establishes for drag-move
finding.evidence: The diff adds `consumeSpillBlocker()` to both `moveRangeTo` clearing loops (sheet.ts:2392, 2461) and re-queues the unblocked anchors so a blocked spill recovers. The sibling path `paste()` clears the cut source range at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2227-2236 (`await this.store.delete({ r, c })`) with no `consumeSpillBlocker()` call and no unblocked-anchor injection into the `dependantsMap` built at line 2219 — and that recalculation happens BEFORE the source clearing anyway. So cutting a cell that was blocking a spill leaves the anchor stuck at `#REF!` exactly like the bug the diff fixes for drag-move. The registration also stays in `spillBlockers`, keyed to a now-empty cell.

verdict.reason: The finding claims paste()'s cut-source clearing bypasses the consumeSpillBlocker() contract, with no consumption and no unblocked-anchor re-queue. Every element of that claim is false in the repository. The cited range (sheet.ts:2227-2236) is not the clearing loop at all — it holds style subtraction and changedSrefs collection. The real clearing loop is at sheet.ts:2254-2265, and it calls `this.consumeSpillBlocker(sref)` at line 2261 immediately after `await this.store.delete({ r, c })` (2260), collecting the result into `unblockedAnchors` at 2262. The finding's sharpest point — that the paste recalculation at 2242-2243 runs BEFORE the clearing — is explicitly handled: the comment at 2269-2270 states the clearing happens after the paste recalculation so the unblocked anchors need their own pass, and line 2271 calls `await this.recalculateWithUnblocked([], unblockedAnchors)`. That helper (1005-1020) adds each anchor to the expanded set before buildDependantsMap (1009-1015), seeds dependantsMap entries for anchors lacking dependants (1016-1018), and calls calculate (1019), so the blocked anchor gets its retry rather than remaining at #REF!. The claim that the registration stays in spillBlockers is also wrong: consumeSpillBlocker deletes the key (994-995). paste() implements the same contract as the moveRangeTo loops (2449, 2518 -> 2529) and removeData (1205), so there is no reachable bypass.

verdict.reason: The claim that `mergeSelection` clears covered cells without consuming spill blockers is false. `mergeSelection` actually starts at sheet.ts:4420 (the reviewer's cited range 4384-4396 is `toggleMergeSelection` and adjacent code, not the merge clearing loop). The clearing loop at sheet.ts:4441-4455 calls `this.consumeSpillBlocker(toSref(ref))` at line 4452 for every cleared non-anchor cell and collects the results into `unblockedAnchors` (declared at 4439 with the exact 'same contract removeData follows' comment). That set is passed to `recalculateWithUnblocked(changedSrefs, unblockedAnchors)` at 4461, which adds the anchors to `expanded` before building the dependants map (1009-1015) and force-inserts any anchor missing from the dependants map (1016-1018). So both the `consumeSpillBlocker` call and the dependants-map insertion the finding says are missing are present on this exact path.

finding.summary: `autofill` overwrite/clear path does not consume spill blockers either
finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2696 and :2706 delete destination cells during autofill and :2679/:2708 overwrite them, then recalc from `changedSrefs` only (line 2714-2719). If an autofilled-over cell was registered in `spillBlockers`, the entry is never consumed and the blocked anchor is never re-queued, so a spill that autofill just unblocked stays `#REF!`. This is the same contract the diff now enforces in `moveRangeTo`; autofill was left on the old behaviour.

verdict.reason: Autofill already implements the exact contract the finding says is missing. In packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts the apply loop declares `const unblockedAnchors = new Set<Sref>()` at :2676 and calls `this.consumeSpillBlocker(normalizedDestSref)` at :2696, adding any returned anchor to `unblockedAnchors` at :2697. That call sits after the ghost-cell skip (:2692) and before every branch that writes or clears the destination — the OLS write (:2734), the missing-source delete (:2751), and the tile delete/write (:2761/:2763) — so all the sites the finding names do consume the blocker. Recalculation is likewise not from `changedSrefs` alone: :2769 gates on `changedSrefs.size > 0 || unblockedAnchors.size > 0` and :2771 calls `recalculateWithUnblocked(changedSrefs, unblockedAnchors)`, which at :1009-1018 folds the anchors into the expanded set before `buildDependantsMap` and seeds missing anchor entries, so a blocked anchor is re-queued and re-attempts its spill. The finding's cited line numbers are stale (:2706 is `trend.ys`, :2714 is a `toPrecision` string), and `grep consumeSpillBlocker` cannot be empty — it matches the definition at :993 and the autofill call at :2696.
